title: Smooth-atlas topology on field-class stack points
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ and discrete presheaf groupoids of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids], the field-object quotient $|\mathcal F|$ and maps $|a|$ of [def-sfb-dm-stack-morphism-properties], and smooth surjective scheme atlases of [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack]. For a scheme $U/S$, a morphism $a:h_U\to\mathcal F$, and $x\in U$, define $p_a(x)$ as the image under $|a|$ of the object of $h_U$ given by the canonical residue-field morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to U$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Equip $|\mathcal F|$ with the supremum of the coinduced topologies of $p_a$ for all smooth surjective scheme atlases $a:h_U\to\mathcal F$. Thus a subset $W$ is open exactly when every such $p_a^{-1}(W)$ is Zariski open. This construction chooses no atlas; its equality with the quotient topology of each atlas for an algebraic stack is a theorem. For a presheaf $P$ and its field-valued representative $(K,s,\xi)$ [def-a1-algebraic-space-point-classes], its corresponding field object of the discrete groupoid of $P$ is the Yoneda morphism $h_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\to P$ determined by $\xi$.
